# iKnowAPDF (https://iknowapdf.lol)
> Free PDF and image tools that run in your browser. Files are processed on the user's device with JavaScript (PDF.js, pdf-lib, Canvas) and are not uploaded to iKnowAPDF's servers. No account required.
> Longer reference for AI agents: https://iknowapdf.lol/llms-full.txt

## Summary
iKnowAPDF is an independent web app built and maintained by Yassine K. It offers PDF compression, merging, splitting, rotation, signing, text editing, scanning, conversion, watermarking, metadata cleaning and image compression. Processing happens locally in the browser tab; the website itself still loads normally and shows ads and uses analytics on the free version.

## Pricing
- All tools are free to use, with no daily usage limits and no watermarks added to output.
- Optional ad-free pass (paid through PayPal) hides ads in the browser where it is activated. It does not unlock extra tools.
- Details: https://iknowapdf.lol/pricing

## Tools
- All tools hub: https://iknowapdf.lol/pdf-tools
- Compress PDF: https://iknowapdf.lol/tools/compress-pdf (Lossless / High Quality, Recommended and Extreme presets; Recommended and Extreme re-render pages as JPEG images)
- Merge PDF: https://iknowapdf.lol/tools/merge-pdf (combine files in a chosen order)
- Split PDF: https://iknowapdf.lol/tools/split-pdf (extract page ranges or split into separate files)
- Rotate PDF: https://iknowapdf.lol/tools/rotate-pdf
- Sign PDF: https://iknowapdf.lol/tools/sign-pdf (drawn, typed or uploaded signatures, date stamps, optional page listing SHA-256 hashes; not a certificate-based digital signature)
- Edit PDF: https://iknowapdf.lol/tools/edit-pdf (edit existing text, add text, shapes, images, whiteout; edited pages are flattened on export)
- Scan to PDF: https://iknowapdf.lol/tools/scan (camera or photo capture, crop, perspective correction, filters; no OCR)
- Convert: https://iknowapdf.lol/tools/convert (PDF to/from Word, Excel, PowerPoint, text)
- Images to PDF: https://iknowapdf.lol/tools/images-to-pdf
- PDF to Images: https://iknowapdf.lol/tools/pdf-to-images
- Watermark PDF: https://iknowapdf.lol/tools/watermark-pdf
- Sanitize PDF: https://iknowapdf.lol/tools/sanitize-pdf (clears document metadata and XMP, rebuilds the file without old revisions, optional form flattening)
- Compress Image: https://iknowapdf.lol/tools/compress-image
- Unlock PDF: https://iknowapdf.lol/tools/unlock-pdf (removes a PDF password the user knows, or print/copy/edit restrictions, with qpdf compiled to WebAssembly; does not crack unknown passwords)
- HEIC to JPG: https://iknowapdf.lol/tools/heic-to-jpg (iPhone HEIC/HEIF to JPG or PNG, batch ZIP download; works in browsers without native HEIC support)
- HEIC to PDF: https://iknowapdf.lol/tools/heic-to-pdf (several HEIC photos into one PDF, A4 or photo-size pages)

## FAQ
- Are files uploaded? No. The PDF tools read files in the browser and produce the result locally. This can be checked in browser developer tools (Network tab).
- Is there a file-size limit? None is imposed by iKnowAPDF; very large files are limited by the device's memory.
- Can it compress a PDF to an exact size? Size-target pages (for example https://iknowapdf.lol/compress-pdf-under-200kb) aim for the target with up to two passes; long documents may need to be split first.
- Does it do OCR? No. Scanned PDFs stay image-based.
